attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Minnesota state income tax calculation. Implements progressive tax structure per MN tax code (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix:
"Minnesota Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto
result.agi result.mn_standard_deduction_single sub 0 max /result.mn_taxable_income xdef

condition_details.condition_description: MN taxable income under or equal to $32,570
MN taxable income over $32,570 and under or equal to $106,990
MN taxable income over $106,990 and under or equal to $198,630

action_details.action_postfix:
result.mn_taxable_income result.mn_bracket_1_rate mul /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"MN Bracket 1: $" result.state_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

result.mn_bracket_1_limit result.mn_bracket_1_rate mul result.mn_taxable_income result.mn_bracket_1_limit sub result.mn_bracket_2_rate mul add /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"MN Bracket 2: $" result.state_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

result.mn_bracket_1_limit result.mn_bracket_1_rate mul result.mn_bracket_2_limit result.mn_bracket_1_limit sub result.mn_bracket_2_rate mul add result.mn_taxable_income result.mn_bracket_2_limit sub result.mn_bracket_3_rate mul add /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"MN Bracket 3: $" result.state_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

result.mn_bracket_1_limit result.mn_bracket_1_rate mul result.mn_bracket_2_limit result.mn_bracket_1_limit sub result.mn_bracket_2_rate mul add result.mn_bracket_3_limit result.mn_bracket_2_limit sub result.mn_bracket_3_rate mul add result.mn_taxable_income result.mn_bracket_3_limit sub result.mn_bracket_4_rate mul add /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"MN Bracket 4: $" result.state_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Minnesota military retirement income exclusion. Provides 100% exclusion for military retirement pay and SBP payments. Also offers tax credits for combat zone service. Honors MSRRA (spouse income exempt if different domicile) and SCRA (active duty pay exempt if different state of residence). Per MN Stat. § 290.032 (2025).

initial_action.action_description: Initialize Minnesota military retirement exclusion calculation
initial_action.action_postfix: "Minnesota Military Retirement Exclusion Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0 /result.mn_military_retirement_exclusion xdef 0 /result.mn_sbp_exclusion xdef

action_details.action_comment: Apply full exclusion for military retirement pay and SBP payments
action_details.action_postfix:
taxpayer.military_retirement_pay /result.mn_military_retirement_exclusion xdef
taxpayer.sbp_payments 0 gt { taxpayer.sbp_payments /result.mn_sbp_exclusion xdef } if
result.mn_military_retirement_exclusion result.mn_sbp_exclusion add /result.mn_total_military_exclusion xdef
result.agi result.mn_total_military_exclusion sub 0 max /result.mn_adjusted_agi xdef
"Minnesota military retirement exclusion: $" result.mn_military_retirement_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.mn_sbp_exclusion 0 gt { "Minnesota SBP exclusion: $" result.mn_sbp_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto } if "Minnesota total military exclusion: $" result.mn_total_military_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
